data.name: Bozorgmehr
data.gender_notes: Bozorgmehr is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bozorgmehr is a Persian name, derived from the Persian word 'Bozorg' meaning great or big, and 'Mehr' meaning love or beloved. It is a name given to a wise, great, and mighty individual. The name Bozorgmehr carries the meaning “Wise, Great, Mighty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bozorgmehr usually hope their child will grow to embody wise, great, mighty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a wise and noble soul, beloved by Allah.
data.etymology: Bozorgmehr belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wise, Great, Mighty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bozorgmehr total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: بورزجمهر
in_arabic.meaning: اسم كبير يعني الشخص العظيم والكريم في الإسلام
in_arabic.long_meaning: بورزجمهر هو اسم مشتق من الفارسية ويعني الشخص العظيم والكريم في الإسلام. يمتلك هذا الاسم أهمية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يرمز إلى الصفات النبيلة مثل العظمة والكرم. وقد وردت هذه الصفات في القرآن الكريم في عدة آيات، منها قول الله تعالى: 'وإن منكم لمن ليدخرن نفسه إلى أجل مسمى' (الذاريات: 59). يشير هذا الاسم إلى الشخص الذي يتميز بالشجاعة والكرم، وهي صفات محمودة في الإسلام.

in_urdu.name: بزرگمہر
in_urdu.meaning: بزرگمہر کا مطلب ہے: عظیم، کریم، اسلام میں عظیم الشان شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: بزرگمہر ایک فارسی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے عظیم، کریم۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اہم کردار رکھتا ہے، جو عظمت، سخاوت، اور بہادری جیسی صفات کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے۔ قرآن کریم میں ان صفات کا ذکر مختلف آیات میں کیا گیا ہے، جیسے کہ اللہ تعالیٰ کا ارشاد: 'اور ان میں سے ایک شخص ہے جو اپنی جان کو مؤخر کرتا ہے ایک مقرر وقت تک' (الذاريات: 59)। یہ نام ان شخصیات کی خصوصیت ہے جو شجاعت، سخاوت، اور کرم کے حامل ہوتے ہیں، جو اسلام میں محمود صفات ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: बुर्ज़गमेह्र
in_hindi.meaning: इस्लाम में महान और उदार व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: बुर्ज़गमेह्र एक फ़ारसी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है महान और उदार। यह नाम इस्लामी संस्कृति में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है, जो महानता, उदारता और बहादुरी जैसे गुणों का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है। कुरआन में इन गुणों का उल्लेख विभिन्न आयतों में किया गया है, जैसे कि अल्लाह तआला का फरमान: 'और उनमें से एक व्यक्ति है जो अपनी जान को एक निश्चित समय तक के लिए टाल देता है' (अल-ज़ारीयात: 59)। यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों की विशेषता है जो बहादुरी, उदारता और करम के धनी होते हैं, जो इस्लाम में प्रशंसनीय गुण हैं।

in_pashto.name: بزرګمهر
in_pashto.long_meaning: بزرګمهر د فارس څخه اخیستل شوی نوم دی چې معنی یې عظیم او کریم دی. دا نوم په اسلامي کلتور کې مهمه ونډه لري، چې د عظمت، سخاوت او زړورتیا ځانګړتیاوې څرګندوي. په قرآن کریم کې دغو ځانګړتیاوو ته اشاره شوې ده، لکه څنګه چې الله تعالی فرمايي: 'او له تاسو څخه يو سړی دی چې خپله ژوند د يو ټاکلي وخت پورې ځنډوي' (الذاريات: 59). دا نوم د هغو کسانو ځانګړتیا ده چې زړور، سخاوت او کرم لري، کوم چې په اسلام کې ستايل شوي ځانګړتیاوې دي.

in_english.name: Bozorgmehr
in_english.meaning: A great and generous person in Islamic tradition
in_english.long_meaning: Bozorgmehr is a Persian name that signifies a great and generous person in Islamic tradition. It holds significant importance in Islamic culture, representing attributes such as greatness, generosity, and bravery. These qualities are mentioned in the Quran in various verses, such as Allah's saying: 'And among you is he who would wish to be spared for a ready reckoning' (Zariyat: 59). The name Bozorgmehr characterizes individuals who embody courage, generosity, and kindness, which are commendable traits in Islam. It reflects a person of noble character and high moral standing.

data.cultural_impact: Bozorgmehr is a name bearing a rich cultural heritage, hailing from the ancient Persian civilization. Persians have always valued wisdom, courage, and honor. Such qualities are reflected in the meaning and etymology of the name Bozorgmehr. The name is a testament to the Persian pride in acknowledging individuals who are great in wisdom, might, and love. This name carries a legacy of Persian pride and cultural significance.
data.spiritual_significance: Bozorgmehr is a name deeply rooted in Persian spirituality. 'Mehr,' a component of the name, signifies love and the unconditional bond between the Creator and His creation. The name, thus, embodies the spiritual principle of love as a manifestation of the divine connection. The name also signifies the love that individuals hold for the divine, their communities, and their families. The multi-layered meaning of this name underscores the deep spiritual significance and the importance of love in Persian culture and belief.

historical_references.reference: Bozorgmehr was a Persian vizier who served under Adud al-Dawla, the Buyid ruler of Iraq (940-983 CE). He is famous for his diplomacy and military prowess, which enabled Adud al-Dawla to resist the advances of the Buyid overlords and maintain control over Iraq.

Bozorgmehr is also known for his involvement in the 'War of the Sword'. This conflict took place between 1040 and 1055 CE, pitting the Seljuq Turks against the Buyid rulers of Iraq. Bozorgmehr allied himself with the Buyids and fought against the Seljuqs, ultimately being killed during one of the battles.
historical_references.context: War of the Sword, Middle East
